Expected Result: System handles empty search without error

Steps: Enter valid credentials and sign in
Expected Result: User reaches the correct role area

Title: Login with invalid password
Steps: Enter valid email and wrong password

Title: Search by first letters
Steps: Enter a prefix of a job title

Preconditions: Veteran is authenticated with incomplete profile
Expected Result: Application is blocked or user is prompted to complete profile

Steps: Complete required job fields and submit
Expected Result: Job is created and appears in listings

Title: View applicants
Expected Result: Applicants are listed with correct information

Title: Request contact access
Expected Result: Request is created and status is shown

Title: View dashboard
Expected Result: Profile, applications and opportunities are visible
